facts: Phase 0.0 (Repository Baseline and Verification) is the initial phase of a 30-phase orchestration roadmap (phases 0-29) designed for incremental multi-agent development execution.

The repository contains 100+ source files organized in 12 major directories: agents/, contracts/, lib/, orchestrator/, .orchestration/, .claude/, Prompts/, LessonsLearnedKnowledge/, archive/, and documentation files.

Agent definitions total 31 files: 19 core production agents (researcher, engineer, architect, critic, synthesizer, supervisor, commissioner, historian, etc.) plus 12 specialized/reference agents (accessibility advocate, performance engineer, security analyst, design artist, etc.).
Contract schemas total 6 JSON files, all v1 format, covering build/maintenance operations, failure handling policy, and repository context passing.
Library modules total 6 JavaScript files: 5 production libraries (run-tracker, api-server, config-loader, costs.nodetest, test-run-tracker) and 1 example file (example-orchestration).
Historical artifacts include 844 past attempted runs archived in PastAttemptedRuns/ directory, representing ~1.1 GB of experimental data and lessons learned.
The orchestration framework uses PowerShell 7+ for deterministic phase sequencing via Invoke-RoadmapOrchestrator.ps1, which controls which phase runs, in what order, with what dependencies.
State management is file-based JSON (.orchestration/state.json) containing fields: schema_version, run_id, completed[], current, carryover[], total_cost_usd, and history[].
CLAUDE.md is the binding contract for all headless orchestrated runs, specifying division of responsibility: watcher decides which phase runs; Claude decides how to execute and reports true status.
Phase 0.0 acceptance criteria require: repository baseline report generated and committed, asset migration status document created, asset classification and migration strategy documented.

The codebase uses a hybrid tech stack: PowerShell (orchestration), YAML/JSON (agent definitions, contracts, configs), JavaScript (runtime libraries), with TypeScript refactoring planned for library migration.

Agent pipelines follow two templates: build_new_app (9 agents: RepoContextBuilder→Researcher→ConceptualModelContract→Engineer→Critic→Synthesizer→Commissioner→Supervisor→Historian) and maintain_existing_app (10 agents: adds ReviewGate after RepoContextBuilder and PRPublisher after Critic loop).
Agent output contracts are strict JSON-only (no markdown, prose, or code fences); every agent system prompt must end with: 'Return strict JSON only. No markdown, no prose.'

The Critic loop fails when blockers are non-empty OR schema_validation.valid is false OR required traceability IDs are missing; on failure, Engineer is looped back with issues, capped at 3 iterations.

Clarification requests from ConceptualModelContract, Historian, Supervisor, or Synthesizer trigger status=blocked; the clarification text is set as a carryover item and execution stops for human intervention.
RepoContextBuilder has already been run and produced repo_context.json in .orchestration/, providing baseline repository structure metadata.
BASELINE_REPORT.md has been created documenting the complete repository inventory with 100+ files, 12 directories, and 48 total assets classified across 9 categories.

ASSET_MIGRATION_STATUS.md has been created with a comprehensive 48-item asset classification table assigning each asset a migration decision (Preserve, Normalize/Load, Refactor, Archive/Reference) and target phase.

Asset classification decisions follow the Existing Asset Migration Policy: core agents migrate Phase 10, contracts Phase 12, libraries Phase 1-15 with TypeScript refactoring, registries are mixed (active.json normalized, legacy archived).

The orchestrator entry point is Invoke-Orchestrator.ps1 at repo root, which wraps orchestrator/Invoke-RoadmapOrchestrator.ps1 with parameters: Reset, DryRun, MaxPhases, MaxCriticLoops, Effort level, budget caps, AllowedTools.
AllowedTools defaults to 'Read,Grep,Glob,Edit,Write' (Bash excluded by default) to constrain orchestrated runs to file operations only; this prevents uncontrolled system access.
The roadmap is defined in roadmap.json with 39 phases (0.0-2.4), each containing id, title, depends_on[], job_type, objective, and acceptance[] fields.
Phase 0.0 current status in state.json: completed=[], current='0.0', carryover=[], history=[] indicating this is the first phase being executed.
The infrastructure expects .orchestration/capsules/<phase-id>.txt memory capsule files written by Historian with sections: DECISIONS, CONSTRAINTS, INTERFACES, DATA, RISKS, NEXT.
Honesty rule: reporting status=complete on incomplete work gets rejected by independent ReviewGate/Critic verification; true status must be reported to avoid wasting gate cycles.
Technology stack assumptions: Node.js v18+ and npm confirmed available; Vite for frontend build tooling, Express.js for backend API server, TypeScript for type safety.
The project has no existing built application; all deliverables are infrastructure, configuration, agent definitions, and contracts from phases 0-4 Foundation phases before app implementation begins.

Critical success factors: strict JSON output from all agents, honest phase status reporting, deterministic PowerShell orchestration logic separated from Claude execution, durable state.json as single source of truth.

Risk: Phase 0.0 is currently executing. The Researcher agent (this run) must establish trustworthy baseline facts and classify all assets correctly to enable downstream phases to make sound decisions.

The repo uses git (main branch, no uncommitted changes except untracked files in .claude/, .orchestration/, .gitignore, agent directories, documentation files, Prompts/, and scripts ready to be committed).

ROADMAP.md (v2.0) is 104 KB and comprehensive, containing 30 phase definitions with complete acceptance criteria, implementation tasks, file manifests, and review gates for the entire 0-29 phase sequence.

risks.risk: Phase 0.0 baseline completeness not independently verified. Researcher output depends on files created in this same run (BASELINE_REPORT.md, ASSET_MIGRATION_STATUS.md).
risks.impact: If reported as complete but files are incomplete or incorrect, downstream phases 1-29 will operate on faulty baseline data, causing architectural misalignment and rework.
risks.mitigation: Independent Critic/ReviewGate must verify all three acceptance criteria (baseline report, migration status, classification strategy) exist and are internally consistent before advancing to Phase 0.1.

risks.risk: Asset migration schedule (Phase 10 for agents, Phase 12 for contracts, Phase 1-15 for libraries) is ambitious and assumes no blocking dependencies discovered during phases 1-9.
risks.impact: If earlier phases (1-9) require agent, contract, or library assets not yet migrated, phases will be blocked waiting for migration.
risks.mitigation: During phases 1-9, track asset dependency requests in carryover items; if blocking dependencies emerge, amend phase schedule before Phase 10.

risks.risk: Honesty rule violations: if any Claude phase agent reports status=complete when work is incomplete, the independent ReviewGate will reject it and block the roadmap.
risks.impact: Each violation wastes one gate cycle and requires amendment rerun; repeated violations consume budget and delay delivery.
risks.mitigation: Emphasize in every agent system prompt: report true status based on actual acceptance criteria met. Include explicit checklist in Critic output.

risks.risk: AllowedTools set to 'Read,Grep,Glob,Edit,Write' excludes Bash, limiting operational flexibility if phases require system commands for testing or setup.
risks.impact: Phases dependent on Bash commands will fail or require parameter override to proceed.
risks.mitigation: Maintain minimal Bash allowlist in Invoke-Orchestrator.ps1 for system-level operations; review and whitelist only on explicit need.

risks.risk: Repository contains 844 historical artifacts (1.1 GB) in PastAttemptedRuns/ which may clutter file searches and slow operations if not excluded from glob patterns.
risks.impact: File discovery and search operations become slower; unintended artifact inclusion in scope.
risks.mitigation: Add .gitignore entry for PastAttemptedRuns/ and exclude from all repo globbing; document pattern in search guidelines.

risks.risk: Agent system prompts are complex and interdependent; error in appending 'Return strict JSON only. No markdown, no prose.' to one agent breaks the pipeline if JSON parsing fails.
risks.impact: Single agent system prompt defect causes Critic loop to fail on schema_validation; phase loops back to Engineer capped at 3 iterations then blocks.
risks.mitigation: Establish automated validation: all agent system prompts must be validated for JSON append before phase execution; Critic must test JSON parsing on all outputs.

risks.risk: State.json is the single source of truth but is only updated at phase boundaries; mid-phase failures leave state inconsistent.
risks.impact: If orchestrator crashes mid-phase, no recovery mechanism exists to resume from last known state.
risks.mitigation: Implement atomic state updates: write state.json only after phase completion; add transaction log for mid-phase checkpoints if resumability required.

risks.risk: Phase 0.0 is currently executing (current='0.0' in state.json); if this Researcher run fails, no baseline facts are available for Critic review.
risks.impact: Downstream Critic loop cannot evaluate completeness; phase will block or loop without sufficient information.
risks.mitigation: Ensure Researcher output JSON is valid and complete; Critic must validate schema before proceeding to verdict.

risks.risk: roadmap.json has 39 phase definitions (0.0-2.4 inclusive) but CLAUDE.md references 'phases 0.4–2.4', suggesting earlier phases (0.0-0.3) may be out of scope.
risks.impact: Confusion about which phases are in-scope; roadmap execution may terminate early.
risks.mitigation: Clarify phase scope: confirm whether phases 0.0-0.3 are part of the active orchestration or are preparatory bootstrap phases outside the main roadmap.

risks.risk: Historian memory capsules (.orchestration/capsules/<phase-id>.txt) are required output but there is no validation that they are created or well-formed.
risks.impact: Downstream phases may lack historical context if capsules are not written; orchestrator loop continues without verification.
risks.mitigation: Critic must verify presence and format of memory capsule before marking phase complete; add automated schema validation for capsule format.

risks.risk: Carryover amendments are communicated as string[] but lack structured format (no JSON schema for amendment items); ambiguity in amendment semantics.
risks.impact: Next phase may misinterpret amendments or fail to address them; amendments accumulate as backlog without closure.
risks.mitigation: Define carryover amendment schema with fields: type, priority, description, phase_affected, resolution_status; enforce at Critic review gate.
